Windows Volume Control - Quick Start
=====================================

This package contains multiple implementations for controlling
Windows audio volume. Choose the one that best fits your needs.

Quick Usage Examples:

Batch (Simplest):
  cd batch
  volume.bat set 75

PowerShell (Recommended for admin):
  cd powershell
  Import-Module .\AudioController.ps1
  Set-AudioVolume 75

Python (For developers):
  cd python
  pip install pywin32
  python audio_controller.py set 75

C++ (Maximum performance):
  cd cpp
  VolumeController.exe set 75

C# (.NET applications):
  cd csharp
  AudioVolumeController.exe set 75

For detailed documentation, see README.md
